title: Generative AI for IT Leaders
overview: This training course is designed to equip IT leaders with a deep understanding of generative AI technologies, their applications, and strategic implementation within organizations. The course will cover AI fundamentals, ethical considerations, use cases, governance, and how to drive AI transformation effectively. IT leaders will gain insights into how generative AI can enhance productivity, decision-making, and innovation while ensuring responsible adoption.
methodology: Capstone project: AI strategy roadmap for an enterprise
competencies: Upon completing this course, participants will develop competencies in:
Understanding the fundamentals and impact of generative AI
Evaluating and selecting AI solutions for business needs
Strategic planning for AI adoption in IT environments
Ensuring ethical and responsible AI deployment
Managing AI risks, security, and governance
objectivesIntro: By the end of this course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Explain key generative AI concepts and how they apply to IT leadership.
Assess AI-driven opportunities for business and IT operations.
Develop AI strategies aligned with enterprise goals.
Mitigate risks related to data privacy, security, and bias in AI systems.
Lead AI initiatives and communicate their value to stakeholders.
Implement governance frameworks to manage AI projects responsibly.
Leverage generative AI tools for productivity and innovation.

items.text: Definition and evolution of generative AI
Overview of AI, machine learning, and deep learning
Key generative AI models (GPT, DALL·E, BERT, etc.)
